title: LiveTipsDeliveryResult
description: live.tips-delivery-result@1: the answer of POST /internal/tips/deliveries on OpenVibe.Live: 200 { ok: true, ref } naming what was made (the saved chat message for chat_line/paid_message, the stream spoken on for tts, the queued media request); the same answer again for a repeated Idempotency-Key. Refusals are { error }: 400 without an Idempotency-Key, 404 creator without a Live channel (permanent), 409 the same delivery is still running (retry), 422 unknown effect, no text, or a media request that failed.
